verdict.rationale: Typesense's own guide walks through the exact quickstart flow: creating a "books" collection, adding books to it, and searching for them. Documented install paths (Docker, Homebrew, binaries, packages) make starting locally straightforward, and a community comment praises the readme and website for explaining the product well. The "within minutes" time-to-first-search claim has no direct evidence, and no hands-on report times the onboarding, so coverage of the full story is incomplete. missing for 10: evidence that the quickstart completes within minutes (timed or hands-on onboarding reports), independent corroboration of the end-to-end quickstart experience.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create an index, add documents, and run my first search within minutes of starting the quickstart
